propositions: T15 criterion must be added to the plan-review registry to enforce that risky runtime-only mechanisms are proved via fast out-of-loop experiments before committing them into slow delivery loops
T15 applies when a mechanism is delivered via automated pipeline, one pass is slow/costly, and correctness only resolves at runtime (boot, auth, connect, readiness)
T15 checks must report findings for: risk naming, fast out-of-loop proof, prove-then-codify sequencing, and scoped cleanup of transient experiments
T10's rubric must be partitioned to exclude transient de-risk experiments from its durable-infrastructure scope
Acceptance criteria require rebar CLI support, criteria-guide regeneration, writing guide updates, and verification that the partitioning scope clause appears in both T10 rubric and criteria-guide
